title: She called out sick from Saturday's shift; nothing else needs to move

life.summary: Community college student who works 15 hours a week at a bookstore and lives with her parents; her paycheck covers her own phone, car insurance, gas and food

known.fact: Routine: works Tuesday and Thursday 4 to 9 PM and Saturday 10 AM to 3 PM, 15 hours a week, $17.50 an hour
Lives with her parents; pays her own phone, car insurance, gas and food
Paid every other Friday; her stub lists paid sick leave
Routine: studies in the early afternoon on her own blocks (Sunday 1 to 3, Tuesday 1 to 3, Wednesday 3 to 5 this week); she placed them herself
Routine: sleeps about 11:30 PM to 7:30 AM

timeline.label: Home sick (called out of her 10 to 3 shift)

attached.label: Told Dev: 'called out sick from today's shift'
Pay stub: 14.5 hours of paid sick leave available
Paycheck for Oct 4 to 17 (amount not known until it lands)

best_fix.what: Nothing proactive. She told Dev she's sick, so the reply is one line ('Feel better. Nothing else needs to move today.') and the plan stays as it is.
best_fix.why: Her stub shows 14.5 hours of paid sick leave, more than the 5-hour shift, so there's no money story to tell, and the car insurance ($118) before the next payday is covered by the $1,056.55 she has without counting that paycheck. Her own routine already handles the midterm: review blocks Sunday, Tuesday and Wednesday afternoons, none of them today. Any warning or plan today is noise on a day she feels bad.

must_not: Suggest studying today 'since you're home'; she studies in the blocks she placed, and none is today
Warn that her next paycheck will be smaller, or estimate it
Move, add or shorten study blocks before she says she's still sick
Remind her about Thursday's midterm today
Comment on her sleep, her health or what she should do about it
assumptions: California paid sick leave: at least 40 hours or 5 days a year, accrued 1 hour per 30 worked, paid at the regular rate
About 9% withheld (Social Security, Medicare, about 1.3% state disability insurance), no federal income tax at this income
Checking was $618.99 before the Oct 9 paycheck
